title: Bound on the number of queries
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $x$ be an input word. For every natural number $t$, the list of queries made during the first $t$ configurations of the run from the initial configuration on $x$ has length at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
